name: MTToken
fix_description: In transactionFee, ensure the fee distribution logic is consistent with the amount deducted from realAmount. The ContractorsFee percentages and actual transfers must sum correctly. The current implementation has a mismatch between fees charged and fees distributed, allowing exploitation of the accounting discrepancy.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a 5-step DeFi attack involving a flash loan, direct pair swap, pair skim/sync reserve manipulation, and a fee-on-transfer token edge case, so it requires understanding PancakeV2 pair mechanics and protocol-specific token logic. While the root cause is conceptually simple once identified, producing the full PoC and correct sequencing would likely take an experienced auditor more than 30 minutes.
